paper_title: Searching for dark matter with an unequal delay interferometer
coupling_convention: d_me, dimensionless (upper limit for d_me as plotted)
notes: DAMNED unequal-delay interferometer (ultra-stable optical cavity + fibre delay line) searches for oscillating scalar DM in mass range [4.1e-11, 8.3e-10] eV (freq [10,200] kHz). Constrains BOTH d_e (fine-structure alpha, ScalarPhoton) AND d_me (electron mass, ScalarElectron) via a 'maximum reach' one-at-a-time approach; results presented for two models (standard galactic DM with rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3, and Earth relaxion halo). Coupling type is ambiguous between ScalarElectron (d_me) and ScalarPhoton (d_e). Numerical 95% upper limits are only shown in Fig. 3 (no data table, no explicit coupling numbers in text), so no reliable (mass, coupling) pairs could be extracted. Claimed improvement of ~1 order of magnitude over Eot-Wash near cavity resonance for galactic model; up to 5-6 orders for relaxion halo model. | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: FIG. 3 bottom-right panel: 95% CL upper limit on d_me (Earth relaxion halo model), blue DAMNED curve. Excluded region is above the curve. The paper presents both d_e (ScalarPhoton, fine-structure variation via optical cavity) and d_me (ScalarElectron) panels with nearly identical shapes; per hint I traced the d_me (ScalarElectron) Earth-relaxion-halo panel, but there is real ambiguity with the ScalarPhoton d_e panel. Curve envelope sits near 0.03-0.1 with several narrow downward resonance dips (deepest ~2e-6 near 1.3e-10 eV) marking enhanced sensitivity; gray markers indicate resonance minima.
